_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the SO-101 joint position limits (radians; gripper in metres), in this
repository's URDF convention: zero is the arm pointing straight up (forward_kinematics in
applications/so101/scripts/so101_common.py). Edit the limits only here: urdf/so101.urdf.xacro reads this
file, urdf/so101.urdf is generated from it (regenerate_urdf.sh), and so101_common.py (simulators, mock sim,
Gazebo relay, CBF controller, GR00T bridge, HIL guard), the GR00T scripts (so101_joint_limits.py) and the
SmolVLA server load it from /workspace/systems or the repository checkout.
Derivation: so101_new_calib_rad are TheRobotStudio Simulation/SO101/so101_new_calib.urdf limits, whose zero
is LeRobot's calibrated mid-range pose. They are mapped into this URDF with the nominal calibration in
lerobot_joint_mapping.json: limit = sign * so101_new_calib + radians(offset_deg). shoulder_pan and wrist_roll
have sign -1, so their lower and upper limits swap and change sign. Values are rounded outward to 1e-5 rad.
The gripper is modelled as a 0-0.04 m prismatic jaw, not new_calib's revolute jaw, so it is not derived.
tests/test_so101_joint_limits.py recomputes the derivation and checks every consumer and both URDF files.
